messages:
Mira (Product): I pushed a new mock for the Audit Log export flow. Need quick UX + accessibility sweep before we lock copy.
Sam (Design): skimmed. layout is tighter now which is good. nit: the filter group label 'Presets' reads as ephemeral; recommend 'Saved filters' or 'Saved views' for discoverability.
Matt (Eng): FYI current CSV header order is `timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days`. Changing visible labels will break scripts. We can ship an adjacent manifest file with header mappings.
Elaine (Security): request: if the export includes any KMS key identifiers or aliases we must surface a clear caution: "Export contains key metadata. Ensure destination complies with your org's export controls." Also log an audit event when a user opts in.
Aria (A11y): accessibility checklist: 1) filter chips need explicit `role=button` and `aria-pressed` toggles; 2) saved filter menu must support arrow-key navigation and focus visible; 3) when an export starts, announce "Export started" and subsequent progress via `aria-live=polite`.
Sam (Design): good catches. Visual nit: the tiny KMS lock badge (purple) at 12px has insufficient hover contrast for the tooltip text. Solution: swap to a high-contrast stroke or increase the badge touch target and add text label for clarity.
Matt (Eng): proposed implementation: emit `export_manifest.json` next to the CSV. Manifest fields: `export_version`, `headers`, `header_aliases`. We'll keep legacy CSV behavior for v1 and add manifest for v2 so parsers can opt-in.
Elaine (Security): agree on manifest. Also want an explicit opt-in checkbox labeled 'Include key metadata' default OFF. For enterprise orgs require typed confirmation `I understand that this export contains key metadata` before enabling.
Mira (Product): checkbox default OFF sounds privacy-first. For non-enterprise, a simpler warning modal is fine.
Aria (A11y): modal requirements: focus trap, initial focus on the typed-confirm input, `aria-describedby` pointing to the security copy. Ensure the typed field has clear validation messaging read by screen readers.
Sam (Design): microcopy proposals: button text when enabled: `Download CSV (includes key metadata)`; when disabled: `Download CSV`. Tooltip: `Includes audit log fields. Only include key metadata if required.`
Matt (Eng): dev plan: add manifest, header aliasing, feature-flagged typed-confirm flow for enterprise, and the checkbox. ETA for review: EOW.
opsbot: deploy-preview created: http://preview/redwood/feature/audit-export-ux (auto)
Mira (Product): owners: Matt (backend), Sam (microcopy/visuals), Aria (a11y sign-off), Elaine (security copy). I'll draft the PR checklist and land copy tweaks tomorrow unless objections.
